caption: The drawing depicts a single object, an ornate oil lamp standing upright at the center of an off-white or beige background. The lamp is predominantly a silvery-gray color, composed of a detailed, faceted glass or crystal body with vertical and oval patterns giving it a textured appearance. The base of the lamp is broad and hexagonal, tapering upwards into a rounded stem that widens again near the main body. At the top, the lamp has a metal cap with two wicks protruding vertically, and a chain is attached to the cap with a small, conical snuffer on the end. There is a brownish color visible inside the glass, indicating the presence of oil. The drawing is signed in the bottom right corner with the name "P. Ward."
title: Camphene Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
